Steam istemcisinin günlükleri, çökme dök: Client logs, crash dumps and the HTTP cache of the Steam client; nothing related to games or accounts is lost.
Epic'in destek makalesindeki gibi siline: The launcher's webcache folders, removed exactly as Epic's support article instructs; fixes display issues, games are not touched. The launcher must be closed.
Epic Games Launcher günlük dosyaları; ya: Log files of the Epic Games Launcher; only troubleshooting history is lost.
Battle.net başlatıcısının önbellek ve gü: Launcher cache and log folders of Battle.net; game installs and install locations are not touched (unlike Blizzard's ProgramData reset). Battle.net must be closed.
Riot Client'ın tarihli günlük dosyaları;: Dated log files of the Riot Client; only support/troubleshooting history is lost.
VALORANT'ın yazdığı oyun günlük dosyalar: Game log files written by VALORANT; only troubleshooting history is lost.
npm'in içerik adresli paket önbelleği; p: npm's content-addressable package cache; packages are re-downloaded on the next install.
npx/npm exec'in anlık kurduğu paketler v: Packages installed on the fly by npx/npm exec and npm debug logs inside the npm cache folder; npx downloads packages again when needed.
pnpm'in genel içerik adresli deposu; yal: pnpm's global content-addressable store; prefer pnpm store prune, which only removes packages no project references. Sizes are overstated because project node_modules are hard links into it.
pnpm'in kayıt defteri meta verisi ve dlx: Registry metadata and dlx caches of pnpm; refetched on the next install.
Yarn Classic'in genel paket önbelleği; Y: Global package cache of Yarn Classic; global packages in Yarn\Data are not touched, packages are re-downloaded.
Yarn 2+ genel (mirror) önbelleği; projel: Global (mirror) cache of Yarn 2+; project-local .yarn/cache folders are not touched, packages are re-downloaded.
Bun'ın genel deposu dahil genel paket ön: Bun's global package cache including its global store; projects that link into the global store need bun install again.
pip'in HTTP ve wheel önbelleği; wheel do: pip's HTTP and wheel cache; wheels are downloaded or built again when needed.
uv'nin paket önbelleği; uv belgeleri ell: uv's package cache; uv's docs say not to edit it by hand, so the uv CLI is used when available. Existing environments keep working, packages are re-downloaded.
Poetry'nin paket ve yapıt önbellekleri;: Poetry's package and artifact caches; Poetry-managed virtualenvs in the same folder are not touched.
İndirilmiş ve açılmış conda paketleri; o: Downloaded and extracted conda packages; cleaned only with conda clean, because environments can link back into this cache.
pipx run'ın oluşturduğu geçici sanal ort: Temporary virtual environments created by pipx run; installed pipx apps are not touched.
İndirilmiş .crate arşivleri, açılmış kay: Downloaded .crate archives, their extracted sources and git checkouts; Cargo re-extracts or re-downloads them, installed binaries and the index are kept.
go komutunun derlenmiş paket ve test son: Compiled package and test results of the go command; the next build is slower once.
İndirilmiş modül kaynakları (dosyalar sa: Downloaded module sources (read-only files, so go clean -modcache is the right tool); modules are re-downloaded on the next build.
Gradle kullanıcı dizinindeki bağımlılık,: Dependency, transform and build caches in the Gradle user home; stop daemons first (gradle --stop), everything is re-downloaded or rebuilt on the next build.
Proje wrapper'larının indirdiği Gradle s: Gradle versions downloaded by project wrappers; the wrapper downloads the needed version again.
Gradle sürümlerine göre gruplanmış Gradl: Log files of Gradle daemons, grouped per Gradle version; nothing else is affected.
Maven'ın yerel deposu; indirilen bağımlı: Maven's local repository; downloaded dependencies come back, but artifacts you installed yourself (mvn install, install:install-file) cannot be re-downloaded.
Önbelleğe alınmış NuGet akış yanıtları v: Cached NuGet feed responses and package downloads; restore fetches them again.
PackageReference projelerinin doğrudan k: Extracted packages used directly by PackageReference projects; every project needs a restore afterwards and Visual Studio should be closed.
Composer'ın paket, depo meta verisi ve V: Composer's package, repository-metadata and VCS caches; COMPOSER_HOME (global packages, auth.json) in Roaming is not touched.
Deno'nun uzak modül, npm ve derleme önbe: Deno's remote module, npm and compiled caches; origin storage (localStorage in location_data) is kept, which is why deno clean is not used.
Playwright'ın indirdiği Chromium, Firefo: Chromium, Firefox and WebKit builds downloaded by Playwright; projects need npx playwright install again.
Puppeteer'ın indirdiği Chrome sürümleri;: Chrome builds downloaded by Puppeteer; re-downloaded on the next Puppeteer install.
Kurulu her sürüm için Cypress uygulama i: Cypress app binaries for every installed version; re-downloaded on the next install.
@electron/get'in önbelleğe aldığı Electr: Electron release zips cached by @electron/get; downloaded again when a project needs them.
electron-builder'ın önbelleğe aldığı ara: Toolsets (NSIS, winCodeSign and others) cached by electron-builder; downloaded again on the next build.
node-gyp'in yerel eklentiler için indird: Node.js headers and import libraries downloaded by node-gyp for native addons; downloaded again on the next native build.
TypeScript dil hizmetinin JavaScript pro: @types packages that the TypeScript language service downloads for JavaScript projects; editors fetch them again when needed.
Her JetBrains IDE sürümünün önbellekleri: Caches and indexes of every JetBrains IDE version (same data as File > Invalidate Caches); Local History is kept, projects are re-indexed on next open. The IDE must be closed.
Her JetBrains IDE sürümünün günlük dosya: Log files and thread dumps of every JetBrains IDE version; only troubleshooting history is lost.
Her Visual Studio örneğinin MEF bileşen: MEF component cache of each Visual Studio instance; rebuilt on the next start, often fixes extension load errors. Visual Studio must be closed.
Android Studio sistem klasörlerindeki ön: Caches, indexes and logs in Android Studio's system folders; settings and plugins in Roaming are not touched. Android Studio must be closed.
Android SDK içindeki emülatör işletim si: Emulator OS images in the Android SDK; any virtual device built on a removed image stops booting until the image is reinstalled with the SDK Manager.
Diskleri, yüklü uygulamaları ve anlık gö: Emulator devices with their disks, installed apps and snapshots; this is user data inside the emulators and cannot be recovered.
dart pub ve flutter pub'ın indirdiği pak: Packages downloaded by dart pub and flutter pub; every project needs pub get again and globally activated tools must be reactivated.
Tüm Docker imajlarını, konteynerlerini,: Virtual disks holding all Docker images, containers, volumes and build cache; never delete them, prune unused data with Docker instead (volumes are kept).
Kurulu WSL dağıtımlarının ext4.vhdx disk: ext4.vhdx disks of installed WSL distributions; they hold the whole Linux file system, so they are only measured (exact paths: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Lxss\*\BasePath).
Unity Package Manager'ın genel kayıt def: Unity Package Manager's global registry cache; packages already in projects stay, new installs need a connection to fetch them again.
Başlatıcıyla kurulan motorların eski dos: Legacy file-system Derived Data Cache of launcher-installed engines; disposable, the editor rebuilds shaders and assets on next open (slow).
Unreal Engine 5.4+ sürümlerinin yerel DD: Zen storage server data used as the local DDC by Unreal Engine 5.4+; Zen garbage-collects it itself, so it is only measured.
İndirilmiş Ollama model blob'ları ve man: Downloaded Ollama model blobs and manifests; every model has to be pulled again (often many GB). Keys and config in .ollama are not touched.
huggingface_hub ile indirilen modeller,: Models, datasets and spaces downloaded through huggingface_hub; re-downloaded on next use. The login token in the parent folder is not touched.
Xet parça önbelleği ve yükleme hazırlık: Xet shard cache and upload staging data; only upload deduplication and resumable uploads are affected.
datasets kitaplığının önbelleğe aldığı A: Arrow files and downloads cached by the datasets library; datasets are downloaded and processed again on next load.
LM Studio'nun varsayılan modeller klasör: Model files downloaded in LM Studio's default models folder; they must be downloaded again. Credentials and settings in .lmstudio are not touched.
torch.hub'ın indirdiği depolar ve ağırlı: Repositories and weights downloaded by torch.hub; downloaded again on next load.
openai-whisper paketinin indirdiği Whisp: Whisper checkpoints downloaded by the openai-whisper package; downloaded again on next use.
Office eklentilerinin Wef ve web önbelle: Wef and web caches of Office add-ins; store add-ins download again, but sideloaded add-ins are removed and some add-ins ask you to sign in again.
Bulut belgelerinin yerel kopyaları, yükl: Local copies of cloud documents, including edits that have not finished uploading; measured only. Clear it in Office under File > Options > Save > Cache Settings > Delete cached files.
Klasik Outlook'ta açılan eklerin kopyala: Copies of attachments opened from classic Outlook, often left behind after a crash; an attachment you edited and saved there exists only in this folder.
OneDrive eşitleme istemcisinin tanılama: Diagnostic logs of the OneDrive sync client; sync state and your files are not touched, and logs in use are skipped.
Dropbox klasörünüzdeki gizli .dropbox.ca: The hidden .dropbox.cache folder inside your Dropbox folder; Dropbox empties it every few days by itself and keeps recently deleted files there for a short time.
Masaüstü için Google Drive'ın günlük dos: Log files of Google Drive for desktop; the file cache with pending uploads is not touched, and logs in use are skipped.
Masaüstü için Google Drive'daki çevrimdı: Offline copies and files waiting to upload in Google Drive for desktop; measured only, because deleting it loses uploads in progress. Turn off offline access in Drive instead.
Signal Desktop'ın tarayıcı önbellekleri,: Browser caches, logs, the temp folder and the update download cache of Signal Desktop; messages, attachments and the database key are not touched.
Evernote masaüstü uygulamasının tarayıcı: Browser caches of the Evernote desktop app; the local note database (conduit-storage) is not touched.
Microsoft'un Mayıs 2025'te kapattığı Sky: Data of the Skype desktop app, which Microsoft retired in May 2025; measured only, because it may hold your only copy of old chats and media. Export what you need, then uninstall Skype.
iTunes veya Apple Aygıtlar uygulamasının: Device backups made by iTunes or the Apple Devices app; measured only. Delete old ones in Apple Devices or iTunes under Manage Backups.
iTunes'un güncelleme ve geri yükleme içi: iPhone, iPad and iPod firmware files (.ipsw) that iTunes downloaded for updates and restores; they download again when needed, unless you kept an older version on purpose.
VLC'nin oynatılan medya için indirdiği k: Cover art VLC downloaded for played media; fetched again when needed. Preferences, the media library and recent files are not touched.
Plex Media Server'ın eski günlük dosyala: Older log files and crash reports of Plex Media Server; the library database and metadata are not touched, and logs in use are skipped.
Plex Media Server'ın artakalan dönüştürm: Leftover transcode files, resized photo thumbnails and old update installers of Plex Media Server; thumbnails are rebuilt as you browse. Stop the server first.
Hizmet olarak kurulan Jellyfin sunucusun: Temporary transcode files and log files of a Jellyfin server installed as a service; the library, metadata and settings are not touched. Stop the server first.
Kurulum programı olmadan başlatılan Jell: Temporary transcode files and log files of a Jellyfin server started without the installer; the library, metadata and settings are not touched.
Premiere Pro, After Effects ve Audition': Audio waveform (.pek) files that Premiere Pro, After Effects and Audition draw on the timeline; rebuilt when a project opens.
Photoshop'taki Camera Raw, Bridge ve Lig: Decoded raw image data shared by Camera Raw in Photoshop, Bridge and the Develop module of Lightroom Classic; rebuilt as you open photos. Same as Purge Cache in Camera Raw preferences.
Adobe uygulamalarının yazdığı çökme günl: Crash logs and minidumps written by Adobe apps, normally removed after upload but often left behind; they can grow to many gigabytes.
Blender'ın kalıcı varlık kitaplığı dizin: Blender's persistent cache of asset library indexes and GPU shaders; rebuilt automatically. Preferences, add-ons and autosaves are not touched.
CapCut masaüstünün indirilmiş efektleri,: Downloaded effects, thumbnails, audio waveforms and the built-in browser cache of CapCut desktop; downloaded again when needed. Projects, drafts, presets and recordings are not touched.
OBS Studio'nun oturum günlükleri, çökme: Session logs, crash reports and profiler data of OBS Studio; scenes, profiles and settings are not touched.
OBS Studio'daki tarayıcı kaynaklarının v: HTTP, code and GPU caches of the browser sources and docks in OBS Studio; rebuilt when they load. Cookies and dock logins are not touched.
GIMP'in bir çökmeden sonra tmp klasöründ: Temporary files GIMP leaves in its tmp folder after a crash; GIMP normally deletes them when it closes.
HandBrake'in elle silinene kadar tuttuğu: Activity and encode logs that HandBrake keeps until they are deleted by hand; presets, settings and the queue are not touched.
Windows Paket Yöneticisi'nin ve çalıştır: Diagnostic logs of the Windows Package Manager and of the installers it ran; winget trims its own logs, but installer logs stay behind.
Yarıda kalan Chocolatey yükseltmelerinin: Package backups left by interrupted Chocolatey upgrades (lib-bkp) and failed installs moved aside (lib-bad); installed packages are not touched.
Döndürülmüş Chocolatey günlük dosyaları: Rotated Chocolatey log files (up to 50 copies of 10 MB each); the current logs are kept.
Scoop'un indirdiği kurulum dosyaları ve: Installers and archives Scoop downloaded; installed apps keep working and Scoop downloads again when it needs a file.
Visual Studio Yükleyicisi'nin onarım ve: Packages the Visual Studio Installer keeps for repair and offline changes; measured only. Run the Installer with --nocache once to remove them, or set the KeepDownloadedPayloads policy.
VS Code bir eklentiyi açarken veya kaldı: Temporary folders left when VS Code was closed or crashed while unpacking or removing an extension; VS Code does not clean the unpacking folders later. Installed extensions are not touched.
JetBrains Toolbox uygulamasının günlükle: Logs and leftover IDE downloads of the JetBrains Toolbox App; installed IDEs and their settings are not touched.
Android SDK yöneticisinin geçici ve yarı: Temporary and partially downloaded packages of the Android SDK manager; nothing in use while no SDK install is running.
Artık kullanılmayan, 4.1 öncesi Android: Build cache of Android Gradle Plugin versions before 4.1, which no longer use it; current builds use the Gradle cache instead.
Yan yana kurulu Android NDK sürümleri, ç: Side-by-side Android NDK installs, often several gigabytes each; measured only. Remove versions your projects no longer use in the SDK Manager or with sdkmanager --uninstall.
Insomnia API istemcisinin tarayıcı önbel: Browser caches and logs of the Insomnia API client; collections, environments and response history are not touched.
DBeaver'ın hata ayıklama ve çalışma alan: Debug and workspace log files of DBeaver; connections, scripts and saved credentials are not touched.
GitHub Desktop'ın tarayıcı önbellekleri: Browser caches and logs of GitHub Desktop; repositories, sign-in and settings are not touched.
Docker Desktop'ın ana makine ve sanal ma: Host and VM logs of Docker Desktop and the caches of its dashboard window; images, containers and volumes are not touched.
Rancher Desktop'ın indirdiği Kubernetes: Downloaded Kubernetes (k3s) releases and logs of Rancher Desktop; downloaded again when needed, so offline clusters cannot start until then. Containers and images are not touched.
Podman makineleri için indirilmiş temel: Downloaded base images for Podman machines; existing machines keep working, and a new machine downloads the image again.
Vagrant'ın indirdiği temel kutu imajları: Base box images Vagrant downloaded; measured only. The official command removes outdated box versions and keeps the ones your machines use.
Vagrant çalıştırmalarının ve tamamlanmam: Temporary files of Vagrant runs and box downloads that did not finish.
Varsayılan VirtualBox VMs klasöründeki s: Logs of earlier runs (VBox.log.1 to .3) for virtual machines in the default VirtualBox VMs folder; disks, snapshots and settings are not touched.
Varsayılan Hyper-V klasöründeki sanal di: Virtual disks and checkpoints in the default Hyper-V folder; measured only. Never delete .avhdx files by hand; remove checkpoints in Hyper-V Manager so they are merged.
PowerToys'un indirdiği güncelleme kurulu: Update installers PowerToys downloaded; it normally deletes them after updating.
Yalnızca sorun gidermede kullanılan eski: Older Windows Update and Update Orchestrator trace files (.etl), used only for troubleshooting; Windows keeps writing new ones.
Windows Arama'nın kullandığı veritabanı;: The database behind Windows Search; measured only. If it has grown very large, rebuild it in Indexing Options > Advanced > Rebuild.
Cursor, LM Studio, Unity Hub, Antigravit: Update installers that Cursor, LM Studio, Unity Hub, Antigravity, Comfy Desktop and other Electron apps downloaded; the next update downloads in full instead of as a small patch.
VS Code, Cursor, Slack, Discord ve Claud: Crash minidumps (.dmp) that Electron apps such as VS Code, Cursor, Slack, Discord and Claude keep in their Crashpad folders; useful only for crash reports.
Windows'un paketlenmiş bir uygulamanın ö: npm caches that Windows redirected into the private folder of a packaged app (for example tools started by Claude or Codex desktop); packages download again when needed.
Windows'un paketlenmiş bir uygulamanın k: pip download caches that Windows redirected into a packaged app's folder, mainly the Microsoft Store Python; installed packages in local-packages are not touched.
Claude masaüstü uygulamasının HTTP, kod: HTTP, code and GPU caches and logs of the Claude desktop app; chats, settings, sessions and the Cowork virtual machine are not touched.
Microsoft Store'dan kurulan Codex masaüs: HTTP, code and GPU caches of the Codex desktop app from the Microsoft Store; sign-in and settings are not touched.
Windsurf düzenleyicisinin HTTP, kod ve G: HTTP, code and GPU caches, cached extension packages and logs of the Windsurf editor; settings, unsaved-file backups and workspace state are not touched.
Google Antigravity'nin HTTP, kod ve GPU: HTTP, code and GPU caches, cached extension packages and logs of Google Antigravity; settings, unsaved-file backups and workspace state are not touched.
VS Code tabanlı düzenleyicilerin HTTP, k: HTTP, code and GPU caches, cached extension packages and logs of editors built on VS Code; settings, unsaved-file backups and workspace state are not touched.
LM Studio penceresinin tarayıcı önbellek: Browser caches and logs of the LM Studio window; models, chats and runtimes in the .lmstudio folder are not touched.
Unity Hub penceresinin tarayıcı önbellek: Browser caches of the Unity Hub window; installed editors, projects and sign-in are not touched.
Element (Matrix) masaüstü uygulamasının: Browser caches of the Element (Matrix) desktop app; messages, encryption keys and the search index are not touched.
Mattermost masaüstü uygulamasının tarayı: Browser caches of the Mattermost desktop app; server list, sign-in and settings are not touched.
Bitwarden masaüstü uygulamasının tarayıc: Browser caches of the Bitwarden desktop app; the encrypted vault file (data.json) and settings are not touched.
Logitech G HUB penceresinin tarayıcı önb: Browser caches of the Logitech G HUB window; device profiles, macros and Lua scripts are not touched.
SteelSeries GG penceresinin tarayıcı önb: Browser caches of the SteelSeries GG window; device settings and Sonar configurations are not touched.
Warp terminalinin günlük dosyaları; komu: Log files of the Warp terminal; command history and settings are not touched.
Ollama'nın sunucu, uygulama ve yükseltme: Server, app and upgrade logs of Ollama; models and the chat history database are not touched, and logs in use are skipped.
Comfy Desktop uygulamasının tarayıcı önb: Browser caches and logs of the Comfy Desktop app and the logs and temp folder of its ComfyUI installs; models, workflows, custom nodes, inputs and outputs are not touched.
Comfy Desktop'ın yeni kurulumlar ve onar: Downloaded Python environment archives that Comfy Desktop keeps for new installs and repairs; downloaded again when needed.
Stability Matrix'in günlükleri ve uv pak: Logs and the uv package cache of Stability Matrix; packages, models, images and workflows are not touched.
Jan masaüstü uygulamasının günlükleri ve: Logs and window caches of the Jan desktop app; models, threads, assistants and files are not touched.
AnythingLLM Desktop'ın günlük dosyaları;: Log files of AnythingLLM Desktop; documents, vector databases and chats are not touched.
kagglehub ile indirilen veri kümeleri, m: Datasets, models and competition files downloaded with kagglehub; downloaded again on the next use. Your Kaggle credentials are not touched.
Keras, EasyOCR, DeepFace, rembg, OpenAI: Pretrained weights and datasets that Keras, EasyOCR, DeepFace, rembg, OpenAI CLIP, ModelScope and PaddleX downloaded on first use; downloaded again when needed.
Triton'un derlenmiş GPU çekirdekleri ve: Compiled GPU kernels of Triton and compiled PyTorch C++/CUDA extensions; rebuilt on next use, which for extensions needs the compiler toolchain.
EA uygulamasının günlük dosyaları ve çök: Log files and crash dumps of the EA app; installed games, cloud saves and sign-in are not touched.
EA uygulamasının tarayıcı, arayüz ve oyu: Browser, interface and overlay caches of the EA app; rebuilt on the next start. Sign-in, cloud-save sync and offline data are not touched. EA's own App Recovery > Clear cache does the same and more.
Kullanımdan kalkan Origin istemcisinin b: Web, image and avatar caches left by the retired Origin client; cloud saves and downloaded game packages are not touched.
Kullanımdan kalkan Origin istemcisinin i: Game and DLC packages downloaded by the retired Origin client; measured only, because some installed games may still use them.
Ubisoft Connect'in web, varlık ve teleme: Web, asset and telemetry caches and logs of Ubisoft Connect; save games, installed games and ownership data are not touched.
GOG Galaxy'nin günlükleri, çökme dökümle: Logs, crash dumps and downloaded store artwork of GOG Galaxy; the library database, game support files and settings are not touched.
PC için Xbox uygulamasının günlükleri, g: Logs, image cache, temp files and web caches of the Xbox app for PC; installed games and captures are not touched.
Minecraft: Java Edition'ın oyun günlükle: Game logs, crash reports and launcher web caches of Minecraft: Java Edition, including CurseForge instances; worlds, mods, resource packs, screenshots and accounts are not touched.
Resmî Minecraft Launcher'ın günlük dosya: Log files of the official Minecraft Launcher, including the copy CurseForge uses; launcher profiles and accounts are not touched.
Prism Launcher'ın indirme önbelleği ve g: Download cache and logs of Prism Launcher; instances, worlds, mods and accounts are not touched.
Modrinth App'in indirme önbellekleri ve: Download caches and launcher logs of the Modrinth App; profiles, worlds and mods are not touched.
CurseForge uygulamasının tarayıcı önbell: Browser caches and logs of the CurseForge app; modpacks, instances and sign-in are not touched.
Roblox Player ve Studio'nun günlük dosya: Log files and downloaded update packages of Roblox Player and Studio; installed versions and settings are not touched.
Her Steam kütüphanesindeki oyun ve Atöly: Temporary files of Steam game and Workshop downloads in every Steam library; installed games and their content are not touched.
Steam kuyruğunda bekleyen, yarısı inmiş: Partly downloaded game updates and installs waiting in Steam's queue; Steam downloads them again from the start, and installed game versions keep working.
Steam istemci güncelleme paketleri, depo: Steam client update packages, depot manifests and library artwork; Steam downloads them again when needed, so the next start needs an internet connection.
NVIDIA uygulamasının ve katmanının günlü: Log files of the NVIDIA app and its overlay; driver settings, game profiles and recordings are not touched.
NVIDIA uygulaması ve katman pencerelerin: HTTP, code and GPU caches of the NVIDIA app and overlay windows; sign-in and settings are not touched.
NVIDIA uygulamasının veya GeForce Experi: Driver packages the NVIDIA app or GeForce Experience downloaded and unpacked for installation; downloaded again if you reinstall a driver. Do not clean while a driver install is pending.
NVIDIA hizmet günlükleri ve çökme döküml: NVIDIA service logs and crash dumps
NVIDIA uygulamasının arka plan hizmetler: Service logs and crash dumps of the NVIDIA app's background services; logs in use are skipped.
AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition penceres: Qt shader and pipeline caches of the AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition window; rebuilt on the next start. Game profiles, the recordings gallery and settings are not touched.
AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition'ın her a: Dated log files that AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition writes on each start; its game and gallery databases are not touched.
Overwolf'un ve uygulamalarının günlük do: Log files of Overwolf and its apps; installed apps, settings and recordings are not touched.
Playnite oyun kitaplığının görsel ve web: Image and web caches of the Playnite game library; the library, extensions, themes and backups are not touched.
itch.io masaüstü uygulamasının tarayıcı: Browser caches and logs of the itch.io desktop app; games installed in the apps folder are not touched.
Heroic Games Launcher'ın günlükleri ve t: Logs and browser caches of Heroic Games Launcher; game settings, Epic and GOG sign-in and installed games are not touched.
Amazon Games uygulamasının günlük dosyal: Log files and crash dumps of the Amazon Games app; the game library and installed games are not touched.
Chrome Beta, Dev ve Canary önbelleği: Chrome Beta, Dev and Canary cache
Chrome Beta, Dev, Canary ve Chrome for T: HTTP, code and GPU caches of Chrome Beta, Dev, Canary and Chrome for Testing; history, passwords, cookies and sessions are not touched.
Edge Beta, Dev ve Canary önbelleği: Edge Beta, Dev and Canary cache
Microsoft Edge Beta, Dev ve Canary'nin H: HTTP, code and GPU caches of Microsoft Edge Beta, Dev and Canary; history, passwords, cookies and sessions are not touched.
Brave Beta, Dev ve Nightly'nin HTTP, kod: HTTP, code and GPU caches of Brave Beta, Dev and Nightly; history, passwords, cookies and sessions are not touched.
Thorium tarayıcısının HTTP, kod ve GPU ö: HTTP, code and GPU caches of the Thorium browser; history, passwords, cookies and sessions are not touched.
Yandex Browser'ın HTTP, kod ve GPU önbel: HTTP, code and GPU caches of Yandex Browser; history, passwords, cookies and sessions are not touched.
Naver Whale tarayıcısının HTTP, kod ve G: HTTP, code and GPU caches of the Naver Whale browser; history, passwords, cookies and sessions are not touched.
Cốc Cốc tarayıcısının HTTP, kod ve GPU ö: HTTP, code and GPU caches of the Cốc Cốc browser; history, passwords, cookies and sessions are not touched.
Waterfox tarayıcısının sayfa, başlangıç: Page, startup and thumbnail caches of Waterfox; bookmarks, history, passwords and cookies live in another folder and are not touched.
LibreWolf tarayıcısının sayfa, başlangıç: Page, startup and thumbnail caches of LibreWolf; bookmarks, history, passwords and cookies live in another folder and are not touched.
